static_traits.name: Lin An
static_traits.social_status: 有少数朋友可交谈,但not yet与他们分享自卑感;Divorce后建立新关系受到影响
static_traits.medical_history: without既往心理治疗经历;No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Expresses clearly, fairly cooperative; tone negative, with self-deprecation; often uses absolutist, failure-predicting statements

basic_info.main_problem: 在与Mother的烘焙能力比较中感到自卑与without能,Divorce后这一感觉加重,导致Avoiding trying new things与曾经喜欢的爱好,并影响医学院Learning专注与Interpersonal relationships.
basic_info.core_demands: These feelings of inferiority affect my daily functioning, hinder me from trying new things or enjoying activities I once liked, and I hope to improve this state.
growth_experiences: Divorce后(近一年内)Self-doubt显著加重,开始频繁将自己与Mother的烘焙才能进行比较,逐步发展为广泛的without能感与回避新事物.
家庭背景中Mother以烘焙闻名,这一对比对象在来访者的自我评价中占据重要位置,遇到涉及skill与创造性的任务时易引发自卑与Withdrawal.

core_beliefs: I am not good enough / incompetent

special_situations.event: 与Mother的烘焙能力进行比较,想到自己not会烘焙
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能像Mother那样烘焙,就证明我总体上not行/not够好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避Learning烘焙并减少尝试新兴趣,以避免被验证'not行'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我永远学not会烘焙,我就是not如她

special_situations.event: 健身时举重not yet达到以往水平
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果一次训练达not到标准,就说明我根本not够强,是失败者
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 更用力训练或寻求他人认可来证明自己;若失败则Self-denial
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not适合这个/I am just a failure

special_situations.event: 面对涉及创造性或skill的任务(如需要动手或创造)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我做not好,就会证明我not行,会出丑,所以最好do not尝试
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 提前预判失败并选择回避,以短期降低Anxiety与羞耻感
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will definitely mess up,还是do not试了

special_situations.event: Fluctuations or setbacks in medical school studies
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能保持稳定/完美表现,就说明我not适合读医学院
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Focuses on negative performance, ignores past effort and progress; engages in self-blame
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not good enough,我会把学业搞砸

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and accepted, hopes to prove one's ability and worth
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败,被negate与羞辱;担心再次被抛弃或在关系中暴露脆弱
defense_goal: Through avoiding attempts, reduces the risk of failure and shame
Maintains a 'sense of control' through self-blame and external recognition
Keeps emotions restrained, avoids exposing vulnerability to others

object_relations.self_representation: not够好,容易失败,需要证明自己的Learning者
object_relations.object_representation: 高标准的评判者/比较者(如Mother,他人或内在化的严苛他者)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询师提出用行为实验来检验'I am not good enough'的信念时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 感觉讨论或尝试是要证明自己'确实not行',认为'说这些也改变not了什么'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Tone carries defensiveness and questioning, emphasizing 'that is just how the facts are', rebutting the possibility of change with concrete failure experiences.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked whether one shares inner feelings and inferiority with friends
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为暴露脆弱会被轻视或拒绝,因此not应让他人看到这一面
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 简短回答,Displacement话题,弱化情绪用词,避免具体细节.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: Experiencing a one-time setback in training or study
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将一次表现等同于整体能力not足('我就是not强/not行')
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use事实化语言强调'数据/表现即真相',忽略情绪与情境因素.

manifestations: Difficulty building new relationships after divorce
not愿向朋友透露脆弱面,担心被看轻
在比较与Self-doubt中感到与他人疏离
outcomes: Interest and self-care activities decrease; the sense of meaning in life drops

manifestations: Reduces choices and attempts out of worry about failure, avoiding new things and old hobbies
以'必须表现完美/否则证明我not行'的内在规则限制自身
outcomes: 对自我体验的允许度降低,内在冲突与Increased anxiety

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: 反复自我评价'I am a failure/永远not够好'
在训练与Learning中not断挑错,忽视进步
Overly cautious about expressing vulnerability,担心被看not起

contact_model.definition: 个体克制想对其他人或物做出某个行为的冲动,转而对自己做,将原欲对外发出的能量Turning against the self.
manifestations: not向朋友求助或表达,需要时选择'忍着'
Turns pressure into training harder or self-reproach
Uses self-limitation to avoid the possibility of directly encountering failure with the outside world

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths.
manifestations: Follows the rigid rule of 'must perform perfectly, otherwise it is failure'
将一次失败等同整体negate,自我价值受制于外在标准

positive_force: Has a certain degree of self-observation and willingness to try change (willing to try behavioral experiments)
Has a few contactable friends; potential social support exists
In the past had self-discipline and engagement habits in training and studies
Has tried positive self-talk and mindfulness practice, showing self-help exploration motivation
negative_force: Black-and-white thinking, overgeneralization与灾难化预测等认知偏差突出
Strong need for external validation, tends to confirm self-worth through others' approval
面对涉及skill/创造的任务易回避,短期减轻Anxiety但Reinforcementwithout能感
Divorce后Loneliness与Impaired self-esteem,影响建立新关系与动力
In frustrating situations, excessively focuses on the negative and ignores objective progress (mental filtering)

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids trying new things and previously enjoyed hobbies (such as baking)
antecedent: 面对涉及创造性或skill的任务
想到与Mother的烘焙能力比较
Recently experienced a setback in training or performance
target_behavior.core_reason: Self-worth damaged after divorce, forming cognitive biases of 'all-or-nothing / overgeneralization / predicting failure', worried that failure and shame will be verified
target_behavior.function: 逃避被评判与失败带来的not适,短期降低Anxiety与羞耻感
target_behavior.consequence: Declining interest and life engagement, reduced socializing and self-care, confidence further damaged

target_behavior.behavior: 在训练与Learning中反复Self-denial的负性自我对话(如'I am a failure/永远not够好')
antecedent: 健身时一次表现not如往常
医学院Academic pressure或任务波动
回想与他人(Mother)比较的场景
target_behavior.core_reason: 将单次挫折等同整体能力not足,内化严苛标准并依赖外部认可
target_behavior.function: 试图通过自我苛责获得控制感或促使自己更努力(表面功能),实则维持without能感以避免冒险
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased motivation,注意力受损,进一步Avoiding challenges与尝试

antecedent: When asked or thinking about whether to share inferiority and distress with friends
target_behavior.core_reason: Fears exposing vulnerability and being belittled or rejected; binds self-worth to perfect performance
target_behavior.function: 避免可能的负面评价或Being rejected的风险,短期保持表面安全
target_behavior.consequence: Intensified sense of isolation,难以获得支持,维持消极自我概念
